restrictions.text: Metro curfews for loads over 10' wide, Monday-Friday: San Diego, Sacramento and San Francisco areas no movement 7:00-9:00 a.m. and 4:00-6:00 p.m.; Los Angeles area 6:00-9:00 a.m. and 3:00-6:00 p.m. SF-Oakland Bay Bridge: no permit loads 6:30-9:00 a.m. and 3:30-6:30 p.m.; over 12' wide only 11:00 a.m.-1:00 p.m. weekdays.

Loads requiring a pilot car: no travel from 4:00 p.m. to midnight the day before, and from noon to midnight on the holiday and each day of the holiday weekend - New Year's, Presidents Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving (Thu-Sun), Christmas. Travel allowed midnight/sunrise to noon on those days.

notes: Legal: 102" wide (CVC 35100), 14' high, STAA 53' semitrailer (kingpin to rear axle max 40') with unlimited overall length on the STAA network; California Legal routes have a 65' overall limit.

Escorts depend on the route color on Caltrans pilot car maps. Interstate is modeled as Yellow (multilane): 1 pilot car over 12', 2 over 15', CHP over 16'. Non-interstate is modeled as Green (two-lane, 12' lanes, 4'+ shoulders): 1 over 12', 2 over 14', CHP over 15'. Blue routes need 1 from 11'; Brown routes 1 from 10' and 2 from 12'; Red routes require district consultation.

Pilot car for length: Yellow/Green over 120', Blue over 100', Brown over 85'. On Yellow routes the maximum is one pilot car until width exceeds 15'. Pilot car positions are set on the permit (modeled as front).
CHP escort also required whenever opposing lanes are used or the load must slow to cross structures; Blue/Brown routes also need CHP at 17'+ high.

Variance permit (treated as superload) when height over 17', width over 16' on Yellow / over 15' on other routes, length over 135', or axle weights beyond the purple chart / bridge ratings (structure review). Route survey required over 17' high.
Overweight permits are limited by bridge ratings (Orange 42,800 / Green 52,000 / Purple 60,000 lb per axle group); there is no fixed gross threshold for variance.
